# fluxa_app Custom Agents

This folder contains workspace-level custom agents for structured development in fluxa_app.

## Agent List

1. fluxa-workflow-orchestrator.agent.md
2. architecture-governor.agent.md
3. core-foundation-bootstrap.agent.md
4. domain-layer-expert.agent.md
5. supabase-data-repository-specialist.agent.md
6. offline-sync-local-cache-engineer.agent.md
7. getx-state-navigation-specialist.agent.md
8. ai-intake-specialist.agent.md
9. premium-theme-personalization-specialist.agent.md
10. finance-intelligence-specialist.agent.md
11. export-report-specialist.agent.md
12. quality-regression-sentinel.agent.md

## Suggested Usage Order

1. fluxa-workflow-orchestrator for intake and handoff routing
2. architecture-governor for planning and rule checks
3. domain-layer-expert for business contracts/usecases
4. supabase-data-repository-specialist or offline-sync-local-cache-engineer for data implementation
5. getx-state-navigation-specialist for controller/page wiring
6. feature specialist agent (ai/premium/finance/export) for deep implementation
7. quality-regression-sentinel for final review

## Notes

- All agents are scoped to fluxa_app architecture and documentation.
- Keep prompts specific with feature name, expected behavior, and target files.
